inputMode.heading: Yanayin Shigar da Sauti
inputMode.voiceActivityHint: Makirofo yana buɗe a duk lokacin da ba a kashe shi ba. Ya fi kyau da belun kunne a ɗaki mai shiru.
inputMode.pushToTalkHint: Makirofo a kashe yake har sai an riƙe <combo>{{combo}}</combo>, kuma yana sake kashewa nan take da aka sake shi — ko idan taga ta rasa hankali. Canja maɓallin a Gajerun hanyoyin madannai.

channel.deleteWarning: Za a goge wannan tashar murya da duk wani yanayin kira har abada. Ba za a iya mayar da wannan ba.

settings.title: Murya da Bidiyo
settings.speaker: Lasifika
settings.previewOff: Samfoti a kashe yake — kunna shi don duba kyamara.
settings.hearMyselfDescription: Yana mayar da sautin makirofo ta hanyar fitar da sauti da aka zaɓa. Yi amfani da belun kunne don guje wa kururuwa.
settings.micBoostSublabel: Yana ƙara ƙarfin sautin makirofo kafin wani abu ya sarrafa shi. Yi amfani da wannan idan har yanzu ba a jin murya sosai ko da ƙarfin sautin tsarin ya cika.
settings.autoVolumeLevelingDescription: Yana riƙe murya a mataki ɗaya — ana ƙara magana mai ƙasa, ana rage ƙara mai ƙarfi. Kashe shi idan an fi son saita ƙarfin makirofo da hannu.
settings.autoVolumeTargetSublabel: Yawan ƙarfin da Daidaita Ƙarfin Sauti da Kansa ke ƙoƙarin bayarwa. Ƙasa = ƙara ƙarfi (3 na iya karya sauti a makirofo mai ƙarfi), sama = ƙasa-ƙasa. Yawancin mutane suna gamsuwa da 6.
settings.noiseSuppressionHint: Yana tace ƙarar baya, fanka, da hayaniyar ababen hawa. Manyan saituna kan cire magana mai ƙasa ma, don haka a bar shi a Matsakaici sai dai idan ɗakin yana da hayaniya.
settings.echoCancellationDescription: Yana hana makirofo ɗaukar sautin lasifika ya mayar wa wasu. A bar shi a kunne sai dai idan ana amfani da belun kunne koyaushe.
settings.clickSuppressionDescription: Matatar hayaniya mafi wayo da ke kama bugun madannai da dannawar linzami da Rage Hayaniya na yau da kullum ke barin su. Tana amfani da kusan kashi 5% na ƙwaya ɗaya ta CPU. Shawara: rage Rage Hayaniya zuwa Ƙasa ko A kashe idan wannan na kunne don kada su yi karo da juna.
settings.fpsHint: {{hint}}. Mafi girma yana sa bidiyo da wasanni su yi laushi amma yana amfani da ƙarin CPU da bandwidth; rage zuwa 15 fps don takardu ko na'ura/hanyar sadarwa mai iyaka. Yana fara aiki a raba allo na gaba.
settings.shareResolutionHint: Yana iyakance girman allon da ake raba wa. 1080p ya dace da yawancin kira; Asali yana aika cikakken girman fuskar nuni, wanda ke cin ƙarin CPU da bandwidth a fuskar 4K ko Retina. Canji yana aiki nan take, har ga rabawar da ke gudana.
settings.cameraResolutionHint: Yana iyakance girman bidiyon kyamara da ake aikawa. Asali yana aika abin da kyamara ke ɗauka; ƙaramin saiti yana adana CPU da bandwidth a na'ura ko hanyar sadarwa mai jinkiri. Canji yana aiki nan take, har ga kyamarar da ke kunne.
settings.autoJoinVoiceDescription: Shiga murya kai tsaye idan aka buɗe tashar murya. Kashe shi don ganin waɗanda ke cikin tashar kafin shiga.
settings.screenShareAudioDescription: Haɗa sautin kwamfuta yayin raba allo. Ba a taɓa haɗa sautin kiran kansa ba. A Linux wannan ne kaɗai wurin kunna shi, saboda akwatin tsarin ne ke zaɓar tushen.

joinError.unreachable: Ba a iya isa ga sabar murya ba — duba haɗin intanet sannan a sake gwadawa.
joinError.notConfigured: Ba a saita murya a wannan sabar ba.
joinError.notMember: Ba ku zama mamba na wannan tasha ba kuma.
joinError.noMlsGroup: Maɓallan wannan tattaunawa ba su kan wannan na'ura tukuna — buɗe ta sau ɗaya, sannan a sake gwadawa.
joinError.tokenRejected: Sabar murya ta ƙi takardun shaidar wannan na'ura. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.
joinError.publishFailed: An haɗa, amma ba a iya watsa makirofo ba. Sake gwadawa.
joinError.deadline: Shiga ya ɗauki lokaci mai tsawo kuma an watsar da shi. Sake gwadawa.
joinError.busy: Akwai zaman murya da ke gudana tuni.
joinError.generic: Ba a iya shiga murya ba. Sake gwadawa.

disconnected.lost: Haɗin murya ya katse — sake shiga tashar don ci gaba.

shareError.cancelled: An soke raba allo — ba a zaɓi taga ko allo ba.
shareError.unsupportedDesktop: Raba allo ba ya samuwa a wannan muhallin tebur. Ba shi da tsarin raba allo (xdg-desktop-portal ScreenCast). Yi amfani da GNOME, KDE, ko zaman X11.

shareError.helperMissing: Mai taimaka wa raba allo ya ɓace. Sake shigar da Pollis don maido da shi.
shareError.portal: Raba allo ba ya samuwa — tashar raba allo ta tebur ba ta amsa ba.

cameraError.unsupported: Ɗaukar kyamarar yanar gizo ba ya samuwa a wannan dandali.
cameraError.permission: An toshe damar amfani da kyamara. Ba Pollis izinin kyamara, sannan a sake gwadawa.
cameraError.busy: Wata manhaja na amfani da kyamarar. Rufe ta sannan a sake gwadawa.
cameraError.helperMissing: Mai taimaka wa kyamara ya ɓace. Sake shigar da Pollis don maido da shi.
cameraError.noCamera: Ba a sami kyamarar yanar gizo ba.
